exit: Remove when the minimum WebKitGTK includes the AT-SPI fix.

content-hidden-until-shown-leaves-the-do.summary: Content hidden until a card opens or a row is hovered or focused is not rendered while hidden; a closed span's cards are found from their data.

drawn-input-hint.summary: A textarea draws its hint while empty instead of carrying a placeholder.

loading-text-leaves-after-fade.summary: A loading layer's text is removed once the layer has faded out.

responsive-hide-keeps-a-box.summary: Text hidden at a narrow width stays rendered in a visually hidden box.

hidden-surface-selection.summary: When a retained surface becomes inaccessible, release its browser DOM selection so accessibility text queries cannot use a range in a hidden editor. Logical editor selection stays with the editor.
